description:
Doug takes a time machine to all five of Earth's mass extinctions, from the ice age that may have been started by moss to the asteroid that ended the dinosaurs, and finds out what actually killed most life on the planet each time (and him, most of the time).

Where in time should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
